senses.gloss: f. pl. (cmp. קוּפְלָא I, a. Arab. ḳufl sera, pessulus)

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, end <he>לאחד שהיו בידו שתי ק׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="S01096"><he>קִפְ׳</he></cite>) like one who held in his hand two parts of a lock and took them to the smith &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 3</cite> <he>שרשרת … של ק׳</he> the chain of a padlock.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 40">Ex. R. s. 40</cite>, beg. <he>קפ׳ של תורה וכ׳</he> the lock which guards learning is fear of sin (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 33:6">Is. XXXIII, 6</cite>). Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 175ᵃ [read:] <he>רמ״ח ק׳ … על רמ״ח איברים שהיו בו</he> the Lord put 248 iron locks on his (Goliath’s) 248 limbs; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 706:3">Yalk. Ps. 706</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 126">Yalk. Sam. 126</cite>; (Midr. Sam. ch. XXI <he>כבלים</he>).

senses.gloss: (by adapt. of κεφαλίς) wreaths around a column, capital.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מה העמודים … ק׳ וכ׳</he> as columns have wreaths above and pedestals beneath &c. (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <cite ref="S01108"><he>קיפלוס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:15">Cant. R. to V, 15</cite> <he>קיפלורוסים</he>; Tanḥ. B’har 1 <cite ref="K00436"><he>כותרת</he></cite>); v. <cite ref="S01112"><he>קִיפָלִיס</he></cite>.
